title: Building Blocks in Economics: The Problem of Choice

concepts.learning_objective: Distinguish needs (essentials) from wants (non-essential desires) and classify everyday purchases.
Explain that human wants are unlimited and keep changing, which makes choice necessary.

topics.title: Limited resources, opportunity cost and the PPC

concepts.learning_objective: Explain that resources are limited and have alternative uses, so choosing one use means giving up another.
Define opportunity cost as the value of the next alternative given up.
Interpret a production possibility schedule and curve to find trade-offs and judge efficient output.

topics.title: What economics deals with
topics.ncert_sections: What does Economics Deal with?; Economic Survey

concepts.learning_objective: State the origin and meaning of the word economics and what the discipline studies.
Identify economic entities such as consumers, producers, governments and financial institutions.
Describe how economists use data, surveys and analysis of alternatives to guide decisions.

topics.title: Key questions: what to produce and for whom
topics.ncert_sections: Key Questions in Economics; What to Produce and for Whom?

concepts.learning_objective: Explain how scarcity gives rise to the three key questions of economics.
Analyse trade-offs in deciding which goods to produce, such as water-intensive versus drought-resistant crops.
Explain how producers choose which group of consumers to serve based on needs and purchasing power.
Distinguish labour-intensive and capital-intensive techniques of production.
Analyse the factors that decide the choice of production technique.

topics.title: Economic systems
topics.ncert_sections: Economic Systems and How Choices are Made; Planned, Market and Mixed Economy

concepts.learning_objective: Describe how a planned economy answers the key questions through a central authority.
Describe how a market economy relies on demand and supply with limited government role.
Explain the features of a mixed economy and India's shift after 1991.
